_note: Official KNMI'23 climate scenarios: 30-year means for 2036-2065 against 1991-2020. Projections under six storylines, not forecasts of any particular year or day, and not produced by this project's models.

source.report_title: KNMI'23 klimaatscenario's voor Nederland, gebruikersrapport (KNMI, March 2023)

geographic_coverage: Netherlands average (temperature: De Bilt, De Kooy, Eelde, Vlissingen, Maastricht; rainfall: 13 P13 stations) and two single stations. Rotterdam is not a KNMI'23 location; De Bilt (inland) and Vlissingen (coast) are the nearest published stations.

p_hour_1y_summer.label: Hourly rainfall exceeded once a year, summer

knmi.indicator: uurlijkse neerslag die eens per jaar wordt overschreden

p_day_10y_summer.label: Daily rainfall exceeded once in 10 years, summer

knmi.indicator: 1-daagse neerslagsom die eens in de 10 jaar wordt overschreden

italic_check.rule: italic in KNMI's table <=> the 1991-2020 mean lies inside the 90 % band of the future 30-year mean (natural variability)

notes.rainfall_extremes_reference: Reference amounts of extreme rainfall are the STOWA 2019-19 statistics (user report, footnote 3); the portal bias-corrected their absolute values on 2026-04-22, the relative changes were not changed.
notes.moderate: M scenarios are KNMI's supplementary moderate-emission calculations; L and H are the core four.
notes.low_same_2050_2100: In L the warming stabilises after 2050, so KNMI gives L the same numbers for 2050 and 2100.
